Our mission's spec_docs were the planning docs (North Star + DES); the detailed build spec (agents/beacon/specs/system-awareness-slice-1-state-log.md, merged #601) wasn't referenced, so Forge was dispatched against planning docs. Suggest: a launch confirm step showing repo + spec_docs (editable) before dispatch; make mission spec_docs editable on the card. Owner = Projects-tab-v3 board stream.

briefing.what: When you hit "Launch" on a project, it immediately starts work using whatever documents were attached when the project was first created — and there's no chance to review or swap them first.
briefing.why: We just got burned by this on our own project: it launched against the early brainstorming notes instead of the finished plan, so the team built from the wrong instructions and the work had to be redone.
briefing.suggest: Worth fixing, but carefully — add a quick "here's what we're about to build, confirm or change it" screen before launch, and let people update a project's documents after it's created.

captures.title: Board: card doesn't reflect a successful Launch -> duplicate launches 409 (dogfood)
captures.note: Dogfood 2026-06-19. After a SUCCESSFUL 'Launch build', the project card stays on 'Brainstorm' with the 'Launch build' button still active (no Building/dispatched state shown). Clicking again POSTs /api/projects/launch -> 409 Conflict (sequence already exists), silently reverting to 'Launch build'. Verified via /api/system/build-sequences: sequence 'launch-system-self-awareness-slice-1-state-log' exists, status 'pending'. So the launch worked the first time but the UI gives zero feedback, causing confusing repeated clicks. Suggest: on a successful launch advance the card to Building/dispatched (or disable the button + show queued), and surface the 409 instead of silently reverting. Owner = Projects-tab-v3 board stream.

briefing.what: After you successfully kick off a project build, the board card doesn't change and still shows the 'Launch' button, so it looks like nothing happened.
briefing.why: People click 'Launch' again thinking it failed, which throws a confusing error and makes a working feature feel broken — eroding trust in the tool.
briefing.suggest: Worth fixing soon: have the card clearly move to a 'Building' state once a launch succeeds, but validate the change carefully before shipping so we don't introduce new confusion.

captures.title: Board: add ABORT for a dispatched build (no way to stop auto-merge) — NEXT PRIORITY
captures.note: Dogfood 2026-06-20 proved the board's most dangerous gap: once a build is dispatched there is NO way to abort it before it auto-merges. PR #602 auto-merged a build we'd tried to stop; the duplicate dispatched before we could cancel. FIX = a 'Cancel/Abort build' action on an active project/sequence that (1) marks the build-sequence cancelled, (2) stops the advancer, (3) GUARANTEES nothing from that build auto-merges (mark the dispatch cancelled so Mirror/auto-merge skip it, and/or auto-close its PR), (4) cleans up the Forge worktree/inbox. Invariant: after abort, no PR from that build can land on main. SECONDARY (same area, lower urgency): launch should show + require confirming repo+spec_docs before dispatch, and mission spec_docs should be editable post-create. Build this the CONTROLLED way (not through the board). Owner = Projects-tab-v3 board stream / next build.

briefing.what: Right now, once we kick off an automated build there's no stop button — and last night one we tried to halt went live on its own anyway.
briefing.why: Without a way to abort, a bad or duplicate build can ship to our live product before anyone can intervene, which is exactly how mistakes reach customers.
briefing.suggest: Approve building a reliable 'Cancel build' button as the next priority, and have the team walk you through the safeguards before it goes in given the stakes.

captures.title: Abort-gate fast-follow: close heal_pr_auto_merge 2nd merge path + DM plain-language + queue-release test
captures.note: From the /code-review of the board-abort PR (block auto-merge of cancelled builds). PRIMARY auto-merge path is closed + proven. Fast-follow: (1) MEDIUM — scripts/heal_pr_auto_merge.py (default-OFF detective healer) is a SECOND merge path that bypasses the new cancelled-gate: it scans outbox-notifier.log for outcome=failed (candidate scan ~L374) then shells 'gh pr merge' (merge_pr ~L443) with zero sequence/cancel awareness. Add a _sequence_cancelled-equivalent check before its merge (port the ~25-line scan, or share via sequence_shortcut_helpers) AND verify its live enabled state on the droplet (OURLIBERTY_AUTOMERGE_ENABLED) — if enabled there's a narrow race-window hole (PR logs outcome=failed, then gets cancelled, within 24h). (2) LOW — add 'skipped_sequence_cancelled' to outbox_notifier._REVIEW_PASS_DM_VARIANTS + _render_review_pass_merge_status_line so the queue-release/sweep DM uses plain language, not the raw enum. (3) LOW — add a test driving a cancelled seq's PR through _queue_release/sweep. Build controlled + human-gated merge (touches auto-merge path).

briefing.what: A safety follow-up to fully close the last gap that could let cancelled or failed work slip out the door automatically.
briefing.why: We already shut the main door, but a lesser-used automatic shortcut could still publish something we meant to stop — a rare but real chance of shipping the wrong thing.
briefing.suggest: Worth doing soon, but handle it deliberately with a human checking the change and first confirming whether that shortcut is even switched on in production.

captures.title: State Log: 'Active missions' panel shows STALE phases (done work as DRAFTING) — trust risk

briefing.what: Our internal status page is showing some finished work as still 'in progress,' so the at-a-glance summary doesn't match what's actually done.
briefing.why: When a status page calls completed work unfinished, people stop trusting it — and trust in our own numbers is what the whole operation runs on.
briefing.suggest: Worth fixing soon so the summary reflects reality, but it's not on fire — slot it into the next round of cleanup rather than dropping everything today.
